Rick Scott
(R-Fla.) criticized socialist policies, arguing that government-funded healthcare, food and housing could come at the expense of individual freedom and economic independence.
Scott Criticizes ‘Free’ Government Benefits
On Saturday, Scott made the remarks in an
X
post, warning that promises of "free healthcare, free groceries, free apartments" could give the government greater control over people’s lives.
"Sounds great, but here’s the catch," he said. "The more free stuff government offers, the more FREEDOM it takes."
He argued that "free healthcare" could mean the government decides "what treatment you need & when you can see a doctor."
He similarly said "free groceries" could mean the government determines "what food you get and how much you need."
On housing, Scott said "free apartments" could allow the government to decide "where you live and how much space your family needs."
He also referenced Cuba, writing, "if socialism worked, Havana would be a booming metropolis."
"Socialism is nothing but empty promises, higher taxes, and the death of the American Dream," Scott said.
